open_questions.text: Which specific documents comprise the College's twelve most used forms for template provision?
What is the data structure and volume of the signed records in the current tool to be migrated by 2027-02-28?
Should the optional on-premises deployment be priced separately, and what infrastructure constraints apply?
What support ticketing system or communication channel should be used for responding to severity-one incidents within one hour?
What is the exact schema and rate limit of the College's existing REST API for the student records system mentioned in REQ-0008?
Will the College grant immediate contract award notification after the 2026-12-01 submission to allow sufficient lead time for the 2027-01-11 go-live?

requirements.statement: Each bidder submits its proposal through the College's procurement portal as a single PDF of at most 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC.
requirements.quote: Proposals must be submitted through the College's procurement portal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC.

requirements.statement: The Supplier keeps an audit record of every signature event, including the signer's identity, the time and the document version.
requirements.quote: The Supplier shall keep an audit record of every signature event, including the signer's identity, the time and the document version.

requirements.statement: The Supplier supports signing on current desktop and mobile browsers.
requirements.quote: support signing on current desktop and mobile browsers;

requirements.statement: The Supplier sends a reminder to each signer who has not signed within 72 hours.
requirements.quote: send a reminder to each signer who has not signed within 72 hours.

requirements.statement: The Supplier should provide templates for the College's twelve most used forms.
requirements.quote: The Supplier should provide templates for the College's twelve most used forms.

requirements.statement: The Supplier stores signed documents for ten years.
requirements.quote: The Supplier shall store signed documents for ten (10) years.

requirements.statement: The Supplier should migrate the signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28.
requirements.quote: The Supplier should migrate the signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28.

requirements.quote: The service must integrate with the College's student records system through its existing REST API.

requirements.quote: Bidders may propose an on-premises deployment option.

requirements.quote: The service shall be available 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance.

requirements.quote: The Supplier should respond to severity-one incidents within one hour, at any time of day.

requirements.quote: The service must be live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment.

approach.text: Bid compliance and delivery: assemble the proposal as a single PDF of at most 20 pages and submit it through the College's procurement portal by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC, and ensure the service is live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment.
approach.basis: The portal submission deadline, file format, and page limit are explicitly stated, as is the mandatory go-live date for spring enrollment.

approach.text: Signing platform: support signing on current desktop and mobile browsers, and send a reminder to each signer who has not signed within 72 hours.
approach.basis: The browser environments and the 72-hour reminder window are specified in the requirements.

approach.text: Audit and records: maintain an audit record of every signature event including signer identity, time, and document version, and store signed documents for ten years.
approach.basis: The required audit details and the ten-year retention period are defined.

approach.text: System integration: integrate the service with the College's student records system through its existing REST API.
approach.basis: The integration target and method via existing REST API are defined.

approach.text: Operations and availability: ensure the service is available 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance.
approach.basis: The availability percentage, calculation period, and planned maintenance notification lead time are stated.

risks.condition: Proposal submission is restricted to a single PDF of at most 20 pages, due by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC (SRC-0015).
risks.event: The final assembled proposal exceeds 20 pages or the upload is delayed past 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC.
risks.effect: The proposal is rejected outright without evaluation.
assumptions: The team can format all required technical and pricing details within 20 pages.
risks.trigger: Draft proposal exceeds 18 pages one week before the deadline, or portal upload is attempted less than 4 hours before 12:00 UTC.
responses: Enforce a strict 18-page budget for the draft to leave a two-page safety margin.
Perform a dry-run upload of a dummy PDF via the procurement portal one week prior to the deadline.
risks.residual_exposure: A technical portal outage during the final upload window.

risks.condition: The service must go live by 2027-01-11 for spring enrollment, leaving only 41 calendar days from the bid deadline of 2026-12-01 (SRC-0032).
risks.event: Integration, testing, or user acceptance delays push the deployment past the spring enrollment start date.
risks.effect: Students cannot sign enrollment documents digitally during the peak spring enrollment period.
assumptions: Contract award and mobilization happen immediately upon bid submission without negotiation delays.
risks.trigger: API integration testing is not completed two weeks before the go-live date.
responses: Pre-build and test the student records system REST API integration connector during the bid phase before formal award.
Establish a fallback manual paper signing process for spring enrollment day if the digital service launch slips.
risks.residual_exposure: Student friction and manual administrative overhead if the go-live date is missed.

risks.condition: The migration of signed records held in the current tool is scheduled for completion by 2027-02-28 (SRC-0026), which is after the go-live date of 2027-01-11 (SRC-0032).
risks.event: Students or staff require access to historical signed records during the gap between go-live and migration completion, but the records are still trapped in the legacy tool.
risks.effect: Inability to reference past documents leads to administrative compliance failures and user confusion.
assumptions: Users will not need access to historical records during the transition period.
risks.trigger: A support ticket requests a historical record stored in the legacy tool during January 2027.
responses: Accelerate the migration of signed records to finish prior to the 2027-01-11 go-live date.
Provide designated staff with read-only access to the legacy tool until migration is fully complete.
risks.residual_exposure: Dual-system lookup overhead for staff during the transition period.
